findings.description: The `_holidays_by_year` cache was dropped, so `holidays()` now calls `self._source.holidays(...)` and builds a new frozenset each time. `is_business_day` calls it for every candidate day, and `add_business_days`, `business_days_between` and `roll_forward` step one day at a time. With `JsonHolidaySource`, every step re-reads and re-parses the whole JSON file from disk. `SlaPolicy.overdue` repeats this for every ticket, and each ticket calls `is_business_day` several times. The cost grows with tickets times days times file size.
findings.suggestion: Cache holidays per year inside `BusinessCalendar`, as before, keyed by year since the region is fixed per instance. Alternatively, cache in the source.
findings.title: Per-year holiday cache removed; source is queried on every is_business_day call
